steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Ooh, looks like it's about time. Gotta get to work now.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Lemme see the schedule for today.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Let's get around to Maggy's 'Improvement proposals for Drone Dragonfly operation' and polish off my submissions for today. Get around to the rest later. Then I just gotta wait for her.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Doing maintenance on Saria's armor? Main thing should be giving it a new coat of paint... crap, did I not order paint?!

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Arghh—we're good, we're good. Didn't use it up last time.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Main focus for today'll be that.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: If I get the time, I'll send some orders for a couple new parts. Then I can give all my frontline Meeboos some real maintenance.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Not too happy about Saria's suit here...

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Wonder why it can't charge up properly.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Weird. C'mon, where's the problem, officer?
Mayer! I know you're in there!

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Prime suspect found. We're on Easy Street now.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Just need to restore a failed node, and the whole suit should be back up and working again.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Uh-huh. Optimize charge circuits first. Paint over next. You'll be back to regular service in no time.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: D'you want some extra features while I'm at it? Hmm.
Ugh. I don't know if Kal'tsit's gonna chew me out for abusing privileges...
Who cares. Your fault for acting deaf, Mayer.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Check over your nodes one more time. Gonna be a pain once the paint gets all in you.
Working with earphones in? Aren't you worried someone's gonna spook you?
Let go of me, damnit, let go of me!!
You really blew it, Mayer. I had something good for you, and you wouldn't even open the door for me. Plus, you bit me...

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Sorry, Closure. But, like, you know I bite when someone interrupts my work.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Fine, I'll let you bite me too, then. Fair's fair?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: You're applying anti-Originium paint to a suit right now, I see?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Pass, then. I bite you here and one moment later I'll be in Medical. Not worth it.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Eh, I guess you're not wrong.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: I specifically remember setting it up to automatically open and close. Pretty sure I also set it a moment ago to 'do not disturb.'

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Did you just hack my door?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: No way~~ It was like that when I walked in.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Can you gimme a moment? I'll check the tapes.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: I got a lotta sensitive Rhine material in here, y'know? It'd be bad news for all of us if I lost something.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Nah, you should get back to work for now...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: R—Remember your health and safety regs. This paint's, uh, pretty dangerous, yeah? Things could go wrong with you trying to multitask!

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: It's fine, I've got mechanical arms on it.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Hmm, which program was it again?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Er, Mayer, don't you think this paint's gonna go volatile soon?

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: That paint? It's fine, sheesh. It's inert.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: You could dump it in boiling water and ionize it for three hours, freeze it, and it'd still be good to go the moment it thaws.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Make some smart robots with me?

steps.name: Monitor Feed
steps.text: Ugh. I don't know if Kal'tsit's gonna chew me out for abusing privileges...

steps.name: Monitor Feed
steps.text: Who cares. Your fault for acting deaf, Mayer.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: AaaaghhI'msorryit'smyfault don't sic the Meeboos on me ow ow ow ow waaaghhhhh!!!

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Yeah, go on. What was it you wanted me for?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I wanted you to help me with an explosive-type thingy...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Underlying machine's a Raythean Challenger Hellcat high-performance operation platform...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Topside already has a custom-ordered full-thermal Arts impact generator...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: But it's not working a hundred percent perfect, so I need your help...

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Just take a sniff of this first.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: We're not gonna get any business done with you bawling your eyes out.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Still dunno why you love sniffing the refined lubricant I have in here...

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Guess Warfarin wasn't wrong. There's no blood in your veins, just machine oil.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Enough of that. Let's get real.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: You need me to refit the Raythean Challenger. Raise its attack power. Right?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Also, self-defense, damage resist, and evac plans. After all, we're gonna put a smart little guy in there. Can't have it breaking after one use.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Then you came to the right person.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Remember how there was a little hoard in the hangar? As long as you—

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Even if as a rush job, your commission still lands bottom-right of the very last note.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Any way I can jump the queue?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: So in other words, two months.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Work fast, it'll be fifty days.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Do you really work that fast?!

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Decently. Sometimes inspiration hits and the work's done.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Er... I'll leave you to it, then...

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: You format the door for me first. I need to do its settings over.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Also, strip your sys-op authority off it.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Right now. Straight away. Giddy up.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Did you change the password? Is that why the door's not opening?

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: And that should be about done.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Huh? Someone at the door again?

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Maggy! The door's broken! Push the button on the side and come in!

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: I'm still busy with something for Saria here. Can't lay out the carpet for you.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: So, you need something from me?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Drone plans. Wondering how they're doing?

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Listed out some technical essentials, improvement proposals and required materials. Everything's in that file on the table there. You look through, and if it's all good, we can set up a new time to help you make some fitting parts.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: If you've got issues with it, we'll have a meeting about it.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Which file on which table is it?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Your mechanical arms are pointing at at least four different tables. How should I know which one?

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Ahhh don't pull me! I'm still painting here!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: You can leave paint and keep painting later. Help me find the files first, okay?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: These are your expensed items for last month.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Oh, sorry. I meant this one.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Ain't no thang. Just what I oughta do.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Then I'll be heading out now. Bye-bye.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I almost forgot the most important part!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Can I ask you what the time is right now?

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Huh? You mean me? I eat an energy bar and I'm fine.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I bought it at the cafeteria. They had the freshwater stuff you love today.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I wanted you to come eat with me, but then I lost track of time myself...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: So after I finished eating, I got a portion bagged up to bring over.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: How much longer will you be working?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Well, that's no good. Let me help you out there.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: It's fine, I can do it.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Either you let me help you, or I feed you your meal. Pick one.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Alright fine I get it! Give me a hand.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: *Sigh*... It's only times like these I miss all of Rhine's self-cleaning facilities.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: So why don't you go back?

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: If I went back, they'd set me up with a mountain of annoying work, and I'd have no time to improve my Meeboos.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: And, like, I had to deal with interpersonal stuff there too.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Like you don't have to here?

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: You're always out on fieldwork. You don't know all the politics and warring between sections.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Over there, right? You'd make a new friend one day, turn around, and bam, someone tells you 'they're from the blah-blah section, best you stay away from them.'

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: And what's worse is even if you're in the same section, sometimes your bosses are competing and you're all trying to drag each other down.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: That's stuff I'm, like, just not good at dealing with.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: So I ended up scarpering here.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Sorry, I shouldn't have asked you about...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Then I should be on my way.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Meeboos, can I ask you to keep an eye on her? Otherwise she'll go straight back to work the moment I'm gone.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: My Meeboos don't have voice modules. They won't answer you.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I still have to nag you.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Okay then. This time I'm really off. Bye-bye.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Hmm, maybe I should put those part orders through before I eat—

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Whuah! What the hell are you doing, Meeboos?!

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: It's just a little bit of work. I'm not gonna forget to eat.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Fine, I get it, I'm eating, I'm eating now!

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Mmm, order parts first or fix some Meeboos first?

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Meeboos win out, yeah. Meeboos are more important.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Touch up paint, inspect wiring, update data, replenish energy.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: That's what Meeboo maintenance is made of...

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Still four more on mission duty, and my five reserve ones need servicing too.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Looks like I can get 'em done today.
Mayer! Open up!! Work needs you!
What's got you all smiles and rainbows?

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: You come here. I'll tell you.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Stick your hand out. It's got something good for you.
Huh, don't hear that every day. Wonder what it is?

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Everything I planned this morning is all done!

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Ahh—that doesn't count. I made the executive decision just now to move ordering parts to tomorrow.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Lemme see what I gotta do tomorrow.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Go to the Procurement Department and order parts.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Need to install test equipment for Medical.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Oh, gotta debug my workbench again.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Eat a bowl of instant noodles and then sleep.
